back: Buying and selling of goods and services within one country.

front: What is the chain of distribution?
List five functions of a wholesaler.
back: Bulk breaking, storage, transport, credit, risk bearing, information, some processing (grading, packing).

front: List four functions of a retailer.
back: Sells small quantities to consumers; offers variety; provides services (advice, credit, delivery); passes on information about demand.
Formal: registered, keeps records, pays tax, regulated. Informal: unregistered, few records, little tax, little regulation.

front: Give three roles of informal traders in Zimbabwe.
back: Jobs and incomes; goods in small, affordable quantities; convenient locations and low prices; enterprise skills.

front: Give three problems of informal trade.
back: Little tax revenue; poor quality and consumer protection; congestion; insecure incomes without credit or pensions.

front: When can a retailer cut out the wholesaler?
back: When it is large enough to buy in bulk directly and has its own storage and transport (e.g. a supermarket chain).
